layers_execution_plan.name: State Transition
layers_execution_plan.verification:
Validated updateWorkCommand and claimWorkCommand fully support RET-001 lifecycle:
- updateWork: Permits participant (inventory manager) to update work state with optimistic concurrency control
- claimWork: Atomic claim functionality via repository.atomicClaim() for exclusive restocking execution
- All state transitions preserve WorkId invariant, participants array, and version increments
- Permission checks enforce inventory manager-only authority (only participants/workspace owners can update)
- RET-001 lifecycle states are all valid WorkStatusEnum values (executing/active/completed/settled)
layers_execution_plan.notes: 100% state transition primitive reuse - no new command code created. updateWork handles all status changes, claimWork handles exclusive restocking claim

layers_execution_plan.name: Evidence

layers_execution_plan.verification:
Validated evidence.getByWorkId and repository.addEvidence fully support RET-001 evidence chain requirements:
- addEvidence(): Writes immutable entry to evidence table with work_id/actor_id/type/content for every state change
